# Schilly’s Take Out & Catering Kitchen

> SMOKED. HOMEMADE. MAINE. Take Out • Family Meals • Catering. Slow smoked favorites, homemade comfort food & Maine hospitality.

- Location: 224 Roosevelt Trail, Casco, ME 04015
- Business Hours: Wednesday - Sunday, 11 am - 6pm
- Store Phone #: (207)693-8840
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/schillyseats
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/share/1DnxQNy3wD/

## Menus
- [Take Out Kitchen Menu](https://schillyscatering.com/#take-out-menu): BBQ Plates, White Cheddar Mac & Cheese, Family Size Portions (4 Servings each), Sandwiches, Specialty Items, Specialty Beef Hot Dogs, Sides, Dessert. Prices include Maine State Sales Tax.
- [Catering Menu](https://schillyscatering.com/#catering-menu): Boxed Lunch, Elevated Boxed Lunches, Boxed Salads, Soups & Crock Favorites, Desserts, Party Platters, Boards, and Grazes (serve approximately 10–12 people).
- [Lobster Bakes, Pig Roasts, Weddings](https://schillyscatering.com/#events)
- [Catering Inquiries](https://schillyscatering.com/#catering-inquiries)
